elements.initial_presentation: 19-year-old female presents with 2 days of progressive fatigue, polyuria, polydipsia, abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting. Breathing is rapid and deep (Kussmaul breathing) with fruity breath odor. Vitals: Temp 37.2 C, HR 122 bpm, BP 98/62 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 98%. Lethargic but oriented.
elements.patient_history: Diagnosed with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus 4 years ago. On basal-bolus insulin (Glargine + Lispro). Missed several insulin doses over the last 3 days due to stomach upset. NKDA.
elements.investigation_attachments: Point-of-care Blood Glucose: 480 mg/dL. VBG/ABG: pH 7.18, HCO3 10 mEq/L, pCO2 24 mmHg, Anion Gap 24 (high anion gap metabolic acidosis). Urinalysis: 4+ glucose, 4+ ketones. Serum beta-hydroxybutyrate: 5.8 mmol/L. Potassium: 4.8 mEq/L.

evidence: Avoid giving insulin before checking potassium
